svg.aria-label: Test-image contact sheet: all six misclassifications followed by fourteen correct examples. Titles give true and predicted classes, with one grayscale range. Image data: E. Alpaydin and C. Kaynak, UCI Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits, CC BY 4.0, loaded through scikit-learn.
